ruling.recommended_action: Uphold the $6.61 cancellation fee; no refund (fee would be issued as a voucher only if refunded).

rejected_claims.reason: Rider's argument that the $6.61 is unfair because the driver had not arrived — there is no published Ryde rule giving free cancellation for a driver being late relative to ETA (NS-8 is informational only and no ETA field exists in the record); the fee is governed solely by the 3-minute post-match rule in NS-4.
